criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: The fresh-open shell was compared to all 12 vertices of Purdue GIS BuildingShapesZip4 FID 78. Maximum nearest-shell-vertex error is 0.000093 m. The source ring is preserved. GIS Shape__Area (849.074 m2) conflicts with coordinate-derived ring area (491.251 m2), an unresolved source-data inconsistency.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: The stored anchor and independently projected GIS polygon centroid differ by 0.000008 m. Source corners align with the shell within 0.000093 m; bounds are 37.32 x 20.56 m. This grade verifies the modular local frame, not placement in the campus master.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: The evidence supports one story and aerial roof plan with a white low-slope roof and two rooftop plant masses. The saved asset is 4.52 m tall overall. Eave/roof elevations are explicit estimates; the GIS extrusion field has undocumented units and no target-specific exterior elevation was found.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: Revision 2 adds a west service-door opening and leaf, plus documented interior stall doors and viewing windows. The service door's exact location is inferred; no exterior windows or target-specific facade elevations are evidenced. Visual inspection shows a largely plain, generic exterior with flat color materials and little visible facade articulation.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Fresh open succeeded in Blender 5.2.3 LTS; the named scene/collection contain 145 meshes and 8 materials. There are no images, linked libraries, or materialless meshes. Building-specific source snapshots, evidence, preview/cutaway, and fresh-open validation are present.

findings: The GIS footprint is reproduced with sub-millimeter vertex agreement and the local anchor aligns with the independently calculated polygon centroid.
The GIS Shape__Area field materially conflicts with the area computed from its own polygon vertices; the model follows the source outline and is not rescaled to the inconsistent field.
Roof plan and one-story form have supporting evidence, but eave height, roof elevation, and the inferred service-door position remain uncertain.
The new service opening addresses the previous exterior-access gap, while the facade still reads as a mostly plain mass with little evidence-backed exterior articulation.
This grade is for the standalone modular asset; campus-master linking and neighboring-context placement were not assessed.
